title: vicia ervilia
intro: Vicia ervilia, commonly known as bitter vetch, is a perennial legume plant native to Europe and Asia, characterized by its yellow flowers and edible seeds. The plant has been valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to support digestive health, lower cholesterol levels, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Vicia ervilia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Vicia ervilia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
